title: Food Safety and Standards (Contaminants, Toxins and Residues) Amendment Regulations, 2026
applicable_baseline_until_effective: FSSAI Contaminants Regulations Version IX (03.02.2026), subject to any additional currently effective orders or amendments

runtime_policy.note: This is an amendment-watch register of candidates, not an exhaustive legal mapping. As of 10 October 2026 it must not update active Version IX numeric rules.

changes.change: From 1 December 2026: Lead 'Pulses' becomes 'Pulses and Pulse flours'; Cadmium 'Pulses, excluding soybean dry' becomes 'Pulses and Pulse flours, excluding soybean dry'.
changes.review_scope: Exact flour versus whole-pulse identity and exclusions must be checked; listed flour products are review candidates, not approved blanket mappings.

changes.change: A fish-oil-specific inorganic arsenic note applies from 1 December 2026: 0.1 mg/kg; total arsenic screening followed by inorganic arsenic determination where specified.
changes.review_scope: Fish Oil finished article only; not fish muscle, fish sauce or edible vegetable oil.

changes.change: The article text for total aflatoxins and Aflatoxin B1 distinguishes oils and oilseeds for further processing from ready-to-eat oilseeds.
changes.review_scope: Processing status, identity and sampling basis must be established before applying category limits.

changes.change: Replaces the Saffrole naturally occurring toxic-substances entry with beverages and foods containing mace and/or nutmeg kernel as an ingredient; stated limit 10.
changes.review_scope: Ingredient-triggered, not automatically an assessment of neat Mace or Nutmeg as a finished spice or any unrelated food.

changes.change: Adds seafood entries for Trimethoprim 0.05 and Oxolinic acid 0.3 in the Gazette table. The governing table unit, analyte/residue definition and legal sample basis must be checked before use.
changes.review_scope: Seafood including shrimps, prawns, fish and fishery products. Do not classify fish processing-waste gelatin or unrelated food automatically.
